patterns.note: Full-bleed, high-impact product photography dominates the hero and key content sections, creating a luxurious visual experience.
A striking, oversized serif typeface is used for the brand logo, contrasting with clean, minimalist sans-serif for navigation and body text.
A rich, deep red is used as a primary accent and background for hero imagery, paired with classic black and white for text and surfaces.

The main header shrinks, changes background to solid black, and alters text color from black to white as the user scrolls down, becoming a compact sticky navigation. The hero image also exhibits a subtle parallax effect.
Product listings are presented in a horizontal carousel, allowing for smooth browsing of multiple items within a confined space.

technique_notes: A transforming sticky header that reduces in height, changes its background to a solid color, and inverts its text color once the user scrolls past the initial hero section.
A large hero image that scrolls at a slightly slower rate than the page content, creating a subtle parallax depth effect.
Product collections are displayed using a horizontal carousel component (likely Swiper.js, as detected), enabling users to swipe or click through items.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold serif for the brand logo, with smaller, uppercase sans-serif for navigation and body text. Headings are significantly larger than body text.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp, with mostly square edges on elements like product cards and input fields.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced, with generous vertical spacing between main sections, but tighter spacing within the navigation and product cards.

standout: The dramatic, high-contrast product photography, especially the hero, combined with the bold, elegant serif typography for the brand name. The deep red and gold color scheme evokes a strong sense of luxury and exclusivity.
